slot.brief: Give electronic configuration of a transition metal ion (e.g. Cr2+, Mn2+) and its oxidation state/d-orbital occupancy.

stem: A transition-metal ion has configuration $[\text{Ar}]\,3d^5$ and is formed by loss of three electrons. The ion is:

verdicts.working: Fe is [Ar] 3d⁶ 4s²; removing three electrons removes the two 4s electrons and one 3d electron, giving Fe³⁺ = [Ar] 3d⁵.

working:
$[\text{Ar}]\,3d^5$ contains $18+5=23$ electrons.
The neutral atom has $23+3=26$ electrons, so $Z=26$ ($\text{Fe}$).
$\text{Fe}: [\text{Ar}]\,3d^6 4s^2 \longrightarrow \text{Fe}^{3+}: [\text{Ar}]\,3d^5$.

Independent check: Fe is [Ar] 3d⁶ 4s²; removing three electrons removes the two 4s electrons and one 3d electron, giving Fe³⁺ = [Ar] 3d⁵.
